2_freestanding.desc: The Basic Tank has a low capacity and can be accessed and viewed from all sides.
5_wall_1side.desc: The Wall Tank has a medium capacity, one viewing side and is only accessed at the back allowing you to keep your equipment out of the way of guests.
tank_wall_2side.desc: The Corner Tank has a medium capacity, has two viewing sides and is only accessed at the back allowing you to keep your equipment out of the way of guests.
tank_wall_3side.desc: The Observer Tank has a medium capacity, has three viewing sides and is only accessed at the back allowing you to keep your equipment out of the way of guests.
lagoon_tank.desc: The Lagoon Tank is similar to the Basic Tank but is sunken into the floor, increasing its capacity.
wall_1side_deep.desc: The Deep Wall Tank has a high capacity, one viewing side and is only accessed at the back allowing you to keep your equipment out of the way of guests.
tank_wall_2side_deep.desc: The Deep Corner Tank has a high capacity, has two viewing sides and is only accessed at the back allowing you to keep your equipment out of the way of guests.
tank_wall_3side_deep.desc: The Deep Observer Tank has a high capacity, has three viewing sides and is only accessed at the back allowing you to keep your equipment out of the way of guests.
tank_small_kreisel.desc: A Kreisel Tank has a circular current which stops the animals inside from bouncing off the sides.
tank_rounded.desc: The 'Belfast' Tank has a very high capacity, curved windows, and viewing on all sides.
small_tunnel_tank.desc: The Small Tunnel Tank allows your guests to get right inside the tank leading to greater levels of satisfaction.
tank_wall_outcrop_deep.desc: The Deep Outcrop Tank is useful in situations where you want some tanks down the middle of a room but don't have the width available for regular wall tanks.
u_lagoon_tank.desc: The 'U' Tank is a larger version of the Lagoon Tank and is useful for filling the end of a room while the 'U' shape increases the number of viewing locations.
large_tunnel_tank.desc: The Large Tunnel Tank is great for dividing two areas while giving a new perspective to your Guests.
tank_rounded_corner_external.desc: The 'Chicago' Tank is a high capacity round-edged tank arranged in a corner configuration. It comes in two variants, depending on whether you want the viewing edge to be on the inside or outside edge of the corner.
tank_rounded_corner_internal.desc: The 'Chicago' Tank is a high capacity round-edged tank arranged in a corner configuration. This variant comes with the viewing edge on the inside of the corner.
tank_mega.desc: The Mega Tank is made from Titanium Alloy and advanced polymers to give it the strength to hold a vast volume of water.
